entities.name: Sandra Linkevičienė
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sandra Linkevičienė is a Lithuanian basketball point guard. She won the Lithuanian title in 2000–2008 and the Russian title in 2012, and was voted as the Lithuanian basketball player of the year in 2010 and 2012. Internationally she won EuroLeague bronze medals in 2005 and 2012.
